Connect your AIQUA project
  1. In Appier: Common settings → Integration → SDK → Web SDK.
  2. Register this website URL, then copy your project's snippet into the marked section of dist/index.html.
  3. Set enabled: true in dist/aiqua-config.js, reload, and repeat your shopping actions.

Only future events are forwarded. Earlier local events are never replayed.
